versions.changelog:
Initial release of eastmoney-stock.

- Query real-time stock data from Eastmoney, including price, change percentage, and volume.
- Supports A-shares, Hong Kong stocks (add .HK), and US stocks (add .N).
- Provides top gainers/losers and watchlist queries.
- Designed to answer natural language stock questions in Chinese.
- Data may be delayed by a few minutes.
